properties.name: Electronic Vision(s) — Neuromorphic Computing Architectures
properties.description:
**Johannes Schemmel** — Heidelberg University, Heidelberg (DE)

Designs BrainScaleS, a mixed-signal analog/digital neuromorphic computing platform emulating spiking neural networks in continuous time (~1000x faster than biological real-time, far lower energy than conventional digital compute). BrainScaleS-2 integrates 512 adaptive integrate-and-fire neurons and 131k plastic synapses per chip; BrainScaleS-1 demonstrated wafer-scale neuromorphic integration. Part of the EU EBRAINS research infrastructure. PI Johannes Schemmel holds Heidelberg's Chair of Neuromorphic Computing Architectures and has led the group's ASIC lab since 2008.

[[https://www.kip.uni-heidelberg.de/vision/|Group website]]

Category: Information Technology · Smallest demonstrated: unknown

properties.name: Self-Organizing Systems Research Group
properties.description:
**Radhika Nagpal** — Princeton University, Princeton, NJ (US)

Studies self-organizing computer systems, collective intelligence, and biologically-inspired multi-agent robotics. Created the Kilobots (published in Science, 2014): a swarm of 1,024 coin-sized, $14-each robots that self-assemble into arbitrary target shapes using only local sensing of immediate neighbors, no central controller. Radhika Nagpal moved the group from Harvard SEAS/Wyss to Princeton (Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering + Computer Science) in 2023.

[[https://ssr.princeton.edu/|Group website]]

Category: Information Technology · Smallest demonstrated: unknown
